n: More endgame: ten new Ultra upgrades past the Omega Engine, ending with The Last Engine, plus three new achievements
Holding or swirling on the atom no longer spams rings and sparks: at most 3 rings at once and fewer sparks
The Windows app checks once at launch whether a newer version is available (it only reads a small version file from GitHub)
Keyboard shortcuts now work on any keyboard layout (Ukrainian, Russian and others, not just English), and the number keys switch all 9 tabs
